An unidentified female [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Kal Mpon]] and the '''mother''' of [[Hem Dazon/Legends|Kal Nkai]], later known as Hem Dazon. She lived on a homestead located near their family [[Nest (Cona)|nest]]. This nest was situated within twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of a [[Grand Nest]]. When their Grand Nest went to [[Water war (Cona)|war]] with an adjacent one over scarce [[Water/Legends|water]] resources, her husband Kal Mpon made the decision to relocate their family to safer lands. To do so, they had to pass through an unfamiliar stretch of [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] wilderness. Since Kal was the most experienced water hunter in the group, he accepted the sole responsibility of bypassing [[Plant/Legends|plant]] defense mechanisms to find them water.<ref name="Screen Entertainment" />

Kal was wholly unprepared for the hostile wildlife that inhabited the jungle and was killed by a plant with a [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxin]] defense mechanism. With no stored water and no means to extract it from the hostile plants of the jungle, Kal Nkai and his mother grew desperate. With no other options, they decided to offer their labor to off-worlder [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]] in exchange for water. Kal Nkai supported his mother by working as a package runner. When Kal discovered that the packages contained [[Salt/Legends|salt]], an illegal narcotic on Cona, he decided to play ignorant because he felt he had a responsibility to take care of his mother.<ref name="Screen Entertainment" />

After he became addicted to the salt he was transporting, Kal decided he wanted to leave Cona to see the off-worlder's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of salt water on their homeworld. Kal briefly fabricated the benefits of his leaving to his mother and wished her farewell before joining them on their journey across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. By the time Kal reached [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], his mother had died from unknown causes. Upon hearing the news, Kal's grief and helplessness drove him from the [[Freighter/Legends|ship]] and into [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] where he mourned for four days straight. When the prospectors couldn't get him to budge, they stranded him on Tatooine. Kal Nkai would remain in the cantina where he wallowed in pity.<ref name="Screen Entertainment" />
